newsitem.title: CANADA: Weston sees savings from head office merger.
newsitem.headline: Weston sees savings from head office merger.

text.p: Grocery chain George Weston Ltd will save C$12 million to C$15 million annually starting next year by merging its head office with that of 71 percent-owned Loblaw Cos Ltd, Weston president Richard Currie said.
"There are a lot of changes going on, but it's essentially a consolidation of the two offices," Currie told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"I think annualized (savings) would be in the C$12 (million) to C$15 million range," Currie said. "Probably it'll start being shown in the first of the year."
